root_cause: The MicroModal library's FOCUSABLE_ELEMENTS selector includes hidden/disabled elements (like #retry button with display:none) in the focus trap. When tabbing past the last visible control (#upload), focus moves to the hidden #retry button, then escapes to #help link outside the modal instead of wrapping to the first focusable element (#modal-close).
repair_strategy: Update the FOCUSABLE_ELEMENTS selector in lib/src/index.js to exclude elements that are visually hidden (display:none, visibility:hidden, aria-hidden=true) or have zero size. This ensures only visible, interactive elements participate in the focus trap.
expected_accessibility_effect: Tab key navigation will wrap within the modal dialog as expected per WCAG 2.1.1 and 2.4.3. Screen reader users will not escape the modal unexpectedly when tabbing past the last visible control.
functional_risks: Elements with aria-hidden="true" but visually shown may be excluded from focus order
CSS display:none on focusable elements now correctly removes them from focus trap
verification_requirements: Escape key closes modal and returns focus to #open
Upload flow still works: Enter on #open -> Tab to #filename -> Tab to #upload -> Enter uploads
